scope: Reassess the frozen E18 model after E19-E34 changes to completion evidence, correction protection and search reuse; all workloads are known regressions, not new blind data.
trial: balanced-fourgram only; no training, smoothing, weight or beam changes
hypotheses: H1: completion evidence fixes remove E18 wox long-completion takeover without changing the model.
H2: the previously frozen extension retains cross-domain nonregression under current production search.
H3: longer observed context can resolve known natural homophones such as the E28 lei diagnosis; diagnostic examples are not an accuracy gate.
H4: even if interaction improves, incremental fourgram query/load cost can still block default adoption and must be measured separately.

interaction.gate: Every 1-3 letter state retains baseline first text; personal learning/reload assertions and complete-result repetition pass. Preserve every changed top five.

development.gate: Per-domain top1/top5/recall255 nondecreasing and character errors nonincreasing; combined top1 strictly increases. No post-result parameter search.

knownTestRegressions.gate: Run only if development and short-input gates pass, using the same frozen model; same per-domain nonregression and combined strict top1 increase. These were opened in E18 and are not independent evidence now.

deployment: No factory or asset change in this reassessment. Default adoption additionally needs current Android end-to-end latency/lifecycle, model load/memory and redistribution evidence. Keep rc.4 unchanged.
